recommendation.regulation_context: The 2025 FIA Formula 1 Sporting Regulations do not explicitly state any special restrictions on changing to SOFT compound tyres mid-race beyond the general tyre allocation and usage rules. Drivers must use at least two different specifications of dry-weather tyres during the race, one of which can be the soft compound, but no specific limitation on switching to soft tyres mid-race is detailed in Article 30.1 or 30.2. Therefore, changing to SOFT tyres mid-race is allowed within the overall tyre usage regulations (Article 30.1 and 30.2).
